quotes.text: I went to one of those fancy detox spas once. Five grand a week. They took away my cigarettes, my bourbon, my red meat — I said to the nurse, 'Sweetheart, what exactly is left that you're planning to save?'

quotes.context: The Tonight Show Starring Johnny Carson, NBC, taped appearance, November 1972
quotes.fake_note: I made this one up — Martin's whole brand was the loveable lush who didn't take health culture seriously, so the spa punchline lands perfectly in his voice. The subtle tell is the word 'detox spa,' which wasn't really part of the cultural vocabulary Martin would have used naturally in that era.

quotes.text: My agent called me up and said, 'The studio wants you, but they're worried about your image.' I said, 'Gerald, I am the image. The rest of these people are just well-dressed furniture.'

quotes.context: Interview with Rex Reed, published in Playgirl magazine, October 1973
quotes.fake_note: I made this one up — Davis was famously savage about Hollywood phonies and had a gift for withering put-downs delivered as absolute fact.
